#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""TEMP: export source-derived Git code_facts delta; remove after exact-SHA repair."""
from __future__ import annotations
import base64
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

rel = ".workflow/generated/code_facts.json"
old = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "HEAD:"+rel])
new = Path(rel).read_bytes()
before = old.decode("utf-8").splitlines(keepends=True)
after = new.decode("utf-8").splitlines(keepends=True)
ops = []
for action, a, b, c, d in difflib.SequenceMatcher(
        None, before, after, autojunk=False).get_opcodes():
    if action != "equal":
        ops.append([a, b, after[c:d]])
sha = subprocess.check_output(
    ["git", "hash-object", "--stdin"], input=new).decode().strip()
diff = {
    "old_git_sha": subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD:"+rel]).decode().strip(),
    "new_git_sha": sha,
    "new_sha256": hashlib.sha256(new).hexdigest(),
    "old_lines": len(before),
    "new_lines": len(after),
    "new_bytes": len(new),
    "ops": ops,
}
payload = base64.b64encode(
    json.dumps(diff, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True).encode("utf-8")
).decode("ascii")
chunks = [payload[i:i+1000] for i in range(0, len(payload), 1000)]
print("SW26_FACT_PATCH_HEAD="+subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"], text=True).strip())
print("SW26_FACT_PATCH_OPS="+str(len(ops)))
print("SW26_FACT_PATCH_CHUNKS="+str(len(chunks)))
for i, piece in enumerate(chunks):
    print("SW26_FACT_PATCH|"+str(i)+"|"+piece)
print("SW26_FACT_PATCH_COMPLETE="+str(len(chunks)))
